examples.prompt: Follow up on project deadline extension request
examples.email:
Subject: Following Up on Project Extension Request

Dear Professor,

I hope this email finds you well. I wanted to follow up on my request from last week regarding a possible extension for the final project deadline.

As I mentioned, I've encountered some unexpected challenges that have impacted my progress. I'm committed to delivering quality work and believe an additional week would allow me to do so.

I appreciate your consideration and look forward to your response.

Best regards,
Jordan Taylor

examples.prompt: Thank colleague for help with technical issue
examples.email:
Subject: Thanks for the Debug Help!

Hey Alex,

Just wanted to shoot you a quick thank you for helping me debug that authentication issue yesterday. Your insight about the token expiration saved me hours of head-scratching!

I owe you a coffee ☕

Cheers,
Alex Chen
